purpose: Identify the people, locations, physical props, and actions required by a fictional scene.
rule: Every extracted item needs an exact supporting quote. Missing or ambiguous details must be flagged for human review.

review_criteria.characters: Identify each explicitly named person; unresolved pronouns require review.
review_criteria.locations: Identify an explicitly stated setting. Furniture alone does not establish a setting.
review_criteria.props: List specified physical objects. Vague references belong in uncertainties, not confirmed props.
review_criteria.actions: List explicit scene actions with supporting quotations.
